name: University of Galway
feeMethod: Lists a separate non-EU fee for each course, so the calculator uses each course's own row.
description: University of Galway is a public research university in Galway, founded in 1845 as Queen's College Galway. It has over 19,000 students.
whyIncluded: Its MB BCh BAO is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and the university's Singapore page profiles Singaporean students in its medical programme.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own monthly budget for international students (rent, bills, food, books, personal costs) for 9 months. It has no transport line and its rent figure is well below current Galway rents.
livingCosts.notes: University of Galway Global 'Average Monthly Cost of Living' table for international students: accommodation EUR 400 + utilities EUR 80 = housing; food EUR 260; personal = books and study materials EUR 60 + clothes/laundry EUR 60 + recreation EUR 180 + other EUR 160; total EUR 1,200 a month. The table has no transport line, so transport is 0. The page is undated (read 2026-09-30) and its accommodation figure is far below current Galway rents; the university's accommodation service says a single room in a shared house is c. EUR 700-1,200 a month. The university's separate cost-of-living page lists only item prices, not a budget.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting) (GY207)
programmes.feeBasis: University of Galway's undergraduate fee table now showing 2027/28, non-EU fee for GY207 Commerce (Accounting). The 2026/27 table is no longer online; the levy is assumed included.
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international (non-EU) students. 3 years (4 with an optional international and placement year). Galway raises fees for continuing years, so later years cost more.
programmes.notes: International (non-EU) fee column, course GY207 Bachelor of Commerce (Accounting) on University of Galway's undergraduate fee table, now showing 2027/28: EUR 20,650 p.a.; chose this over the EU fee because Singaporeans pay the non-EU fee. The 2026/27 edition of the table is no longer online (the page rolled to 2027/28), so feeYear is 2027, unlike the file's other Galway programmes (2026). The page does not say whether the figure includes the student levy (EUR 150 is listed in a separate column); treated as levy-inclusive like the earlier years, so compulsory fees are 0. History, same course code and column: 2025/26 EUR 19,140 incl. levy ('EUR 19,000 p.a. (EUR 19,140 including levy)', Common Crawl copy of 9 Dec 2024 of this page); 2024/25 EUR 18,640 incl. levy ('EUR 18,500 (EUR 18,640 including levy)', Common Crawl copy of 21 Feb 2024; GY207 was then titled 'Commerce with Accounting'). 2026/27 not found for GY207 (for reference the file's GY201 Commerce row is EUR 19,390 for 2026, and GY207 equalled GY201 in 2024, 2025 and 2027, but that is not a published GY207 figure so it is not used). Galway applies an approved inflationary increase to continuing years.
